title: ARA Claim
description: One machine-readable link from a manuscript assertion to its originating exploration node.

claim_hash.description: Stable content identity for the assertion/evidence intent.

evidence_refs.description: Content-addressed evidence results supporting this claim.

context_pack_refs.description: ContextPack object hashes supplied to the writer before this claim was produced.

source.description: Stable document hash plus a best-effort human source selector.

node.description: Legacy optional cache of the exploration_graph entry. New producers SHOULD omit it and join by node_id/evidence_refs.
